newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Friday's close, USDA said.
Trade fairly slow. Demand moderate, instances good. Seller interest light. Offerings fairly light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Fridays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established with a higher undertone noted.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1275 lbs few 109.00-110.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
